title: Regression: Environment Variables tool crashes immediately in elevated mode (PowerToys 0.100.1–0.100.2, Windows 11 25H2)
author: ioritree
summary: Environment Variables elevated startup crashed with a consistent WinUI title-bar signature on 0.100.x and one 0.101 prerelease, while a current 0.101.2362 Store install works on a clean machine.

status.label: Handled by active linked fix
status.detail: Issue #49880 and open PR #50027 carry the current CJK/title-bar crash investigation; the latest clean-machine confirmation does not justify competing work.

next_action.label: Follow linked fix
next_action.reason: Keep this report as corroborating evidence for #49880 and PR #50027.

judgment.rationale: The original crash is well substantiated, but the active fix path is already tracked by #49880 and PR #50027. The latest report that 0.101.2362 works on a new machine suggests environment sensitivity rather than a separate new defect.
evidence: Several reporters supplied the same Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll exception e0464645 at offset 0x4bc71 when Environment Variables starts elevated.
Disabling elevated launch was a repeatable workaround on affected 0.100.x systems.
A 0.101 prerelease reporter still reproduced the signature, while the latest commenter reports 0.101.2362 from the Store works on a brand-new machine.
Open issue #49880 and open PR #50027 track the newer CJK/title-bar startup crash path.
judgment.recommended_action: Avoid duplicate design work and follow https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/49880 and https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/50027.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PR #50027 is the concrete current fix attempt for the linked WinUI title-bar startup crash class.

coverage.detail: Current issue carrying fresh crash diagnostics.

issue_context.summary: A reproducible elevated Environment Variables startup crash affected 0.100.x, persisted for one 0.101 prerelease user, and is not reproduced by the latest clean-machine report.
known_information: The failing signature and elevation-only workaround were independently reproduced.
The latest commenter can launch version 0.101.2362 from the Microsoft Store on a new machine.
Issue #49880 and PR #50027 are open and cover the newer title-bar startup crash work.
inferences: Machine locale, upgrade state, or another environment-specific condition may determine whether the remaining crash path is reached.
issue_context.analysis: The new success report changes confidence about universality but not ownership. Existing linked work should converge before any separate PowerToys fix is proposed.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and all seven comments.
Compared the latest clean-machine result with the earlier identical crash signatures.
